data.one_liner: A simple Flutter widget to display customizable string-based tags inside a wrap.
data.what_it_does: Display text-based tags in a wrapping layout. Allows full customization of both the tag text and container styling, along with support for tap, double tap, and long press callbacks.
use_when: You need to display a list of string-based tags inside a wrapping layout.
You want to easily customize tag containers, text styles, and icons.
avoid_when: You require complex form inputs or tag-selection state management out of the box.
strengths: Supports customizable styling for containers, text, and icons.
Provides callback handlers for press, long press, and double tap events.
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic tag display and styling.
Does not include built-in tag selection or deletion state management.
